name: Sickling
description: Sickling test (Sickle Cell Test) screens for sickle cell disease and sickle cell trait by detecting the presence of hemoglobin S (HbS). It is a simple screening test that helps identify individuals with sickle cell anemia or carriers of the sickle cell gene.
literatureReview: Sickle cell disease is a group of inherited red blood cell disorders caused by abnormal hemoglobin (hemoglobin S). The sickling test is a simple screening method that detects the presence of sickle hemoglobin by inducing red blood cell sickling under low oxygen conditions. A positive test indicates the presence of HbS and requires confirmatory testing. Early detection through newborn screening and carrier testing is crucial for managing sickle cell disease and providing genetic counseling.
